texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_JAPON_ATACANTE_1: Wooded mountains close in on both valleys. Only two bridges cross the river below the castle: take the southern valley, or the pass over the hills to the northern bridge.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_JAPON_ATACANTE_2: The castle and its little town above the river fork are our objective. Storm them.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_JAPON_DEFENSOR_1: The river and the mountains guard us. Watch the two bridges and the pass through the woods.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_JAPON_DEFENSOR_2: Hold the castle and the houses beside it. While its walls stand, the valley is ours.
